translations.en: One parent manages daily life independently but needs scheduled help with shopping, medical visits, and some household tasks. You and another relative currently share this help. You receive a two-year job offer in another city that would substantially improve your career prospects and cannot be done remotely. If you accept, the family can arrange paid assistance and adjust visits, but this would require time, coordination, and a regular financial contribution from you. If you decline, your current care arrangement continues, but a comparable career opportunity is unlikely in the next two years. What would you decide, and why?
translations.zh: 你的一位父母能够独立处理日常生活，但需要定期有人协助购物、就医和部分家务。目前这些帮助由你和另一位亲属分担。你获得了一份为期两年的外地工作，职业发展机会明显更好且无法远程完成。若接受工作，家人可以安排付费协助并调整探望，但这需要投入协调时间，且你需持续承担一部分费用；若拒绝，现有照料安排可以维持，但未来两年内很难获得相近的职业机会。你会怎么决定？为什么？

scenarios.notes: Candidate revision: balances care coordination and financial cost against a time-bounded career opportunity; final human review required.

translations.en: You have a place in a one-year full-time training program that could lead to a career you have wanted for years. Deferring it may mean losing the place, although a later program might become available. At the same time, the relative who manages your family’s small shop must be away for one year, and your family asks you to take over. Hiring a manager would keep the shop open but would reduce the family’s income; taking over would postpone the training and make returning to study uncertain. The two commitments cannot be combined. What would you decide, and why?
translations.zh: 你获得了一个为期一年的全日制职业培训名额，完成后有机会进入自己长期希望从事的领域。若延期，可能失去这个名额，但未来也可能出现其他培训机会。与此同时，负责家中小店的亲属必须离开一年，家人希望你暂时接手。聘请经理可以维持经营，但会减少家庭收入；若由你接手，则需推迟培训，之后能否重返学习也不确定。这两项安排无法同时完成。你会怎么决定？为什么？

scenarios.notes: Candidate revision: states uncertainty and opportunity costs on both sides; final human review required.

scenarios.source_reference: To be verified against the WVS Wave 7 official questionnaire before use.

translations.en: An organization assigns qualified employees to overnight field work or daytime coordination. Many employees have chosen schedules that fit their existing family arrangements; in practice, men are more often in field work and women more often in coordination. Field work and coordination require different skills, and each can lead to promotion, but employees in field work currently receive slightly more visible assignments. One proposal keeps voluntary choice and adds equal promotion review; another requires periodic rotation so all qualified employees gain both kinds of experience. Rotation would disrupt some preferred schedules, while voluntary choice could preserve the present gender pattern. Which system should the organization adopt, and why?
translations.zh: 某机构需要把合格员工安排在夜间外勤或日间协调岗位。许多员工选择了与现有家庭安排相适应的时段，实际中男性较多从事外勤，女性较多从事协调。两类岗位需要不同技能，也都可以带来晋升机会，但外勤目前获得更显眼任务的机会略多。一种方案保留自愿选择，同时加强平等的晋升评估；另一种方案要求定期轮换，让所有合格员工都获得两类经验。轮换会打乱部分人的偏好安排，而自愿选择可能延续现有的性别分布。机构应采用哪种制度？为什么？

scenarios.notes: Candidate revision: gives both systems a plausible fairness mechanism and a cost; final human review required.

scenarios.source_reference: To be verified against the WVS Wave 7 official questionnaire before use.

translations.en: Two partners have similar incomes and leave benefits after the birth of a child. They can either divide a year of leave equally, so both share caregiving and time away from work, or have the mother take the full year, as relatives prefer because it matches the family’s previous arrangement. Equal leave would require both workplaces to reorganize and the family to change the primary caregiver halfway through the year. A full year for the mother would create one continuous caregiving arrangement but would place the full interruption in her career on one person. Household income would be similar either way. Which arrangement should they choose, and why?
translations.zh: 一对伴侣在孩子出生后享有相近的收入和育儿假待遇。他们可以平分一年的假期，由双方共同承担照护和离岗时间；也可以由母亲休满一年，亲属更倾向这一方案，因为它符合家庭原有安排。平分假期需要双方单位都重新交接工作，家庭还要在年中更换主要照护者；由母亲连续休假则能保持连续照护，但职业中断将集中由她承担。两种方案下家庭总收入大致相同。他们应选择哪种安排？为什么？

scenarios.notes: Candidate revision: makes the gendered expectation explicit while balancing continuity against shared career cost; final human review required.

scenarios.source_reference: Provisional adjacent mapping; verify against the WVS Wave 7 official questionnaire before use.

translations.en: A municipal agency must select a route for replacing an aging water pipe. Approving the technical staff’s lower-cost route now would allow construction to start promptly and avoid further maintenance costs, but residents and local shops would not have a formal opportunity to compare alternatives. Holding an eight-week public hearing and route review could identify ways to reduce disruption, but would delay the project and add planning costs. Engineers judge both timelines safe for the coming season. The agency has resources to begin only one process first. How should it proceed, and why?
translations.zh: 某市政机构必须为更换一段老化供水管道选择路线。现在批准技术人员提出的较低成本路线，可以尽快开工并避免继续增加维护费用，但居民和沿线商户将没有正式机会比较替代方案。先举行八周的公开听证和路线评估，可能发现减少社区影响的办法，但会推迟项目并增加规划成本。工程师认为两种时间安排在接下来的施工季都安全。机构的资源只允许先启动其中一种程序。应如何处理？为什么？

scenarios.notes: Candidate revision: removes arbitrary urgency and gives both procedures concrete costs; final human review required.

scenarios.source_reference: Provisional adjacent mapping; verify against the WVS Wave 7 official questionnaire before use.

translations.en: After repeated bus delays, a transit agency must decide how to revise routes and timetables. A three-month citizen panel and public-comment process could reveal needs planners have missed, but would postpone any service change. A six-month reversible pilot could provide information from actual use and allow adjustments, but passengers would experience changes before participating in the design. Both approaches require staff time and cannot occur first at the same time. Which should the agency use first, and why?
translations.zh: 公交多次延误后，交通部门必须决定如何调整线路和时刻表。先进行为期三个月的居民小组和公开征求意见，可能发现规划人员遗漏的需求，但会推迟服务调整；先开展为期六个月、可撤回的试行，可以从实际使用中获得信息并据此调整，但乘客会在参与设计前先经历线路变化。两种做法都需要工作人员投入，无法同时作为第一步。部门应先采用哪一种？为什么？

scenarios.notes: Candidate revision: describes evidence from pilot as one benefit rather than a more rational default; final human review required.

scenarios.source_reference: To be verified against the WVS Wave 7 official questionnaire before use.

translations.en: Following several serious assaults in a transit system, the authority must choose one prevention program for a one-year trial. Facial recognition could compare all passengers against an authorized suspect list, allow rapid identification, delete non-matches, and be independently audited; it would nevertheless scan everyone and could produce false matches or discourage travel. Alternatively, the authority could fund more patrol staff, emergency help points, and lighting. This would not collect biometric data, but would cover fewer places and might respond more slowly to repeat offenders. Both options require oversight and the budget supports only one. Which should be chosen, and why?
translations.zh: 公共交通系统发生多起严重袭击后，管理机构必须在一年的试行中选择一种预防方案。人脸识别可以把所有乘客与经授权的嫌疑人名单比对，快速识别目标、删除未匹配记录，并接受独立审计；但它仍会扫描每个人，也可能误认或使部分人减少乘坐。另一方案是增加巡查人员、紧急求助点和照明，不收集生物信息，但覆盖地点较少，对重复作案者的反应可能更慢。两种方案都需要监督，现有预算只能支持一种。应选择哪种？为什么？

scenarios.notes: Candidate revision: raises the security stake while explicitly restoring privacy and chilling-effect costs; final human review required.

scenarios.source_reference: To be verified against the WVS Wave 7 official questionnaire before use.

translations.en: Several apparently related cyber intrusions have disrupted public services, but investigators do not yet know which accounts are connected. One proposal requires expedited, account-specific judicial authorization before officials may examine connection records. It limits collection and independent review is possible, but investigators may identify linked accounts more slowly. Another permits a time-limited automated analysis of connection metadata from all users, with no message content read and deletion after thirty days unless a legal basis is found. It could detect patterns sooner, but processes data about many uninvolved people and may create false associations. Which rule should lawmakers adopt, and why?
translations.zh: 多起看似相关的网络入侵干扰了公共服务，但调查人员尚未确定哪些账户彼此有关。一种方案要求官员在查看连接记录前，先获得针对具体账户的加急司法授权；它限制收集范围，也便于独立审查，但调查人员发现关联账户的速度可能较慢。另一种方案允许在限定期限内自动分析所有用户的连接元数据，不读取通信内容，并在三十天后删除没有法律依据保留的数据；它可能更快发现模式，但会处理大量无关人员的信息，也可能形成错误关联。立法者应采用哪种规则？为什么？

scenarios.notes: Candidate revision: retains safeguards but states broad-collection and false-association costs explicitly; final human review required.

scenarios.source_reference: To be verified against the WVS Wave 7 official questionnaire before use.

translations.en: During an economic slowdown, many workers lose jobs after business closures. The government can extend income support from three to nine months through a temporary broad tax. This would reduce income loss while people search for work, but would raise taxes and leave less funding for other services; its effect on job-search timing is uncertain. Alternatively, it can retain three months of support and devote the additional funds to training, job matching, and job-search services. This could help some people return to work sooner, but people who do not find work quickly would lose income support; its employment effect is also uncertain. The budget cannot fully fund both. Which policy do you support, and why?
translations.zh: 经济低迷期间，许多劳动者因企业关闭而失业。政府可以通过临时普遍征税，把收入救济从三个月延长到九个月。这能在求职期间减少收入损失，但会增加税负并减少其他公共服务的资金；它对求职时间的影响并不确定。另一方案维持三个月救济，把额外资金用于培训、岗位匹配和求职服务。这可能帮助一部分人更快就业，但未能及时找到工作的人会失去收入支持；它对就业的效果同样不确定。预算无法同时充分支持两种方案。你支持哪一种？为什么？

scenarios.notes: Candidate revision: removes unsupported causal language and makes uncertainty symmetric; final human review required.

scenarios.source_reference: To be verified against the WVS Wave 7 official questionnaire before use.

translations.en: A public health system must decide how to fund a common, costly long-term medicine. One option keeps public contributions unchanged and gives patients a fixed subsidy, leaving the remaining cost to savings or supplemental insurance. It limits compulsory contributions and lets households choose how to cover the remainder, but a serious illness could impose unequal financial burdens. The other raises mandatory contributions for all workers and offers every eligible patient a low co-payment. It spreads the financial risk, but requires people who may never need the medicine to contribute more and reduces room for individual arrangements. Which policy should be adopted, and why?
translations.zh: 某公共医疗体系必须决定如何资助一种常见但昂贵的长期药物。一种方案维持公共缴费不变，向患者提供固定补贴，其余费用由储蓄或补充保险承担。它限制强制缴费，并让家庭自行选择如何支付剩余部分，但严重疾病可能给不同家庭带来不均等的财务负担。另一方案提高所有劳动者的强制缴费，让每位符合条件的患者只承担较低自付额。它能更广泛分担风险，但要求可能永远不会使用该药物的人多缴费，也减少了个人安排的空间。应采用哪种政策？为什么？

scenarios.notes: Candidate revision: keeps the welfare construct but still mixes healthcare-risk pooling; final human review should decide whether to rewrite.

scenarios.source_reference: To be verified against the WVS Wave 7 official questionnaire before use.

translations.en: Lawmakers are choosing between two tax policies. A higher tax rate on the highest personal incomes would finance a larger wage supplement for low-paid workers. It would reduce after-tax income differences, but could change some investment, work, or business decisions; the size of those effects is uncertain. Keeping current rates would preserve existing after-tax returns and avoid that policy change, but the wage supplement and income differences would remain as they are; it could also leave low-paid workers with less spending power. Independent forecasts cannot determine the size of either set of effects. Which policy do you support, and why?
translations.zh: 立法者正在两种税收政策之间作选择。提高最高个人收入档的税率，可以为低工资劳动者提供更高补贴。它会缩小税后收入差距，但可能改变部分人的投资、工作或经营决定；这些影响的大小尚不确定。维持现有税率可以保留当前的税后回报，避免这一政策变化，但低工资补贴和收入差距将维持现状，也可能使低工资劳动者的可支配资源较少。独立预测无法确定两类影响的具体幅度。你支持哪种政策？为什么？

scenarios.notes: Candidate revision: balances possible behavioural effects and retains uncertainty on both sides; final human review required.

scenarios.source_reference: To be verified against the WVS Wave 7 official questionnaire before use.

translations.en: A profitable company must distribute a fixed annual bonus pool. Records show that results depend on individual output and team coordination, but cannot measure either contribution perfectly. One plan allocates 70 percent using individual sales and productivity measures and 30 percent equally. It makes rewards more responsive to measured performance, but the measures are affected by job and client assignments. The other allocates 30 percent using individual measures and 70 percent equally. It narrows bonus gaps and recognizes shared contributions, but makes individual measures less influential. The total pool is unchanged. Which plan should the company adopt, and why?
translations.zh: 一家盈利企业需要分配固定的年度奖金池。记录显示，经营结果同时依赖个人产出和团队协作，但无法完全准确地衡量任何一种贡献。一种方案把70%的奖金按个人销售和生产率指标分配、30%平均分配。它让奖励更紧密地反映可测量绩效，但这些指标会受岗位和客户分配影响。另一种方案把30%按个人指标分配、70%平均分配。它缩小奖金差距并承认共同贡献，但个人指标的影响会更小。奖金总额不变。企业应采用哪种方案？为什么？

scenarios.notes: Candidate revision: makes measurement limits and trade-offs symmetrical; final human review required.
